title: Module 3 capsule wash: generator parameters
description: Parameters of cad/generators/m3_wash.py (DRAFT design, from the wash MVP work). Lengths in um unless the name says _mm. x-source: where the default comes from ('the sheet' = the project's geometry requirements sheet); 'Assumption' marks a placeholder.

capsule_count.description: Capsules the trap holds as one layer (sizing.py 'mvp' preset).

swollen_diameter_um.description: Swollen capsule diameter; the chamber must be at least this high.

mesh_opening_um.description: Retention opening; must be < 0.4 x capsule diameter (28 um for 70 um capsules). The brief suggested 30 um, which breaks that rule, so the default stays at the 25 um chosen earlier. The name is historical: this is now the gap of a FABRICATED DEPTH WEIR, not a bought mesh insert - the 200 um fabrication floor is in plane only, so the crest is printed on the same single layer and the gap is in z.
mesh_opening_um.x-source: the sheet (trap gap ~20-30 um; 0.3-0.4 x diameter)

channel_width_factor.description: Channel width as a multiple of the capsule diameter.

inlets.description: Inlets above the trap (spread along it).

backflush.description: Back-flush inlet below the weir crest, to lift the capsules before release.

wash_volume_ul.description: Volume per wash in the protocol.

max_flow_ul_min.description: Wash flow ceiling; the generator lowers it if flow_calc predicts too much pressure on the capsule bed.

margin_mm.description: Plate around the trap (room for ports and channels).
